novelty.justification: The claim’s main novelty route is a new mechanistic relationship: numeral systems that are “vigesimal/irregular” purportedly produce “a distorted, non-linear internal number line,” while word forms are mapped onto a shared “language-agnostic ‘digit-magnitude’ representation.” Searches for “LLM number words numeral system vigesimal arithmetic,” “multilingual numeral transparency internal number line,” and “activation patching cross-lingual numerical magnitude” found no equivalent study; the closest work separates language from concepts through activation patching in “Separating Tongue from Thought” (2024), studies generic numerical representations in Zhu et al. (2024) and Nikankin et al. (2024), or documents numeral typology without analyzing LLM internals in “The Arithmetic of Natural Language” (2022). Connecting these established strands is a substantive natural extension with a new typed predictor and representational prediction, but it does not introduce a fundamentally new interpretability method or problem paradigm, so it fits standard rather than high novelty.
